objectives:
邀請學術界講座，使博士班同學了解最新的財務理論與實務議題。
Academic speech.
This course helps Ph.D. students understand the contemporary research topics in theoretical and empirical finance.
content:
本課程邀請國內外學者發表其最新研究。
We shall invite scholars home and abroad to talk about their current researches.
books:
本課程無教科書，講義於課前以電子郵件傳送給修課學生。
Electronic papers and presentation materials will be distributed before the classes.
grading_policy:
課堂參與40%，心得報告60%。
Attendance: 40%
All Reports: 60%
